## Summary

Describe the change and the research/software problem it addresses.

## Scientific assumptions

State sampling-rate, coordinate, signal, model, or validation assumptions that affect interpretation.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Learned-model changes include leakage-safe validation and uncertainty/calibration evidence
- [ ] Synthetic smoke results are not presented as empirical validation

## Compatibility and provenance

Describe API changes, model/data versions, and reproducibility implications.
